youtube.title: Shahad kabhi kharab kyun nahi hota? 🍯 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Shahad hazaron saal tak kharab nahi hota. Misr ke purane maqbaron mein archaeologists ko shahad ke bartan mile hain, aur woh bhi khane layak.

Raaz yeh hai ki shahad mein paani lagbhag hota hi nahi, aur woh kisi bhi germ ka paani kheench leta hai. Saath hi woh acidic hota hai, aur makkhiyan ek enzyme milati hain jo thoda hydrogen peroxide banata hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
